name: Perplexity
bestFor: Questions that need links, not a confident paragraph
skipIf: You want an IDE, a design tool, or a private document brain without web search
keyFeatures: Inline source citations on every answer
Web, academic, and social corpus filters
limitations: Not a replacement for NotebookLM on private PDFs
summary: A research console that retrieves the web and shows sources. Use it when ChatGPT would invent a citation.
body: Perplexity is the tool we open before we write, not after. It searches, cites, and lets you narrow the corpus (web, academic, or social). You can route some queries through third-party models on Pro ($20/mo monthly or $17/mo annual), which is useful and easy to overspend. It is a weak daily writer compared with Claude and a weak coder compared with Cursor. Rankings that call it a ChatGPT killer miss the job.
notes: Force source mode when the topic is even slightly factual
Pro is worth it if this replaces a pile of Google tabs
Not a replacement for NotebookLM on your own PDFs
